2609.29921.title: Who Holds the Pen? Let Specifications, Not Agents, Sign Off
2609.29921.paper_summary: Large language model agents increasingly combine generation, decision-making, execution, and self-evaluation within a single agentic loop. Although they operate under external specifications such as task instructions, guidelines, output schemas, and reusable skills, these specifications typically remain context for the same model that acts and declares completion, leaving no independent specification authority boundary. We identify two resulting gaps. The understanding--execution gap arises when a requirement is understood but not satisfied in execution; the state--authority gap arises when an agent's interpretation or completion claim does not establish the required state. On SkillsBench, using only agent-visible prompts, workspace information, and injected skill specifications, we extract 509 source-grounded task directions. Across seven models, only 79.6%--86.4% are satisfied, while completion-claim rates exceed official evaluator pass rates by 28.7--37.9 percentage points. We therefore separate agent proposals from authoritative state. Agents may plan, act, and request completion, but only admissible evidence from qualified providers may establish specification-governed state. SpecHarness operationalizes this principle by compiling visible specifications into source-linked obligations and governing execution and finalization through versioned obligation state. Verifiable requirements are mediated or validated at runtime, while ambiguous or subjective requirements remain advisory. Experiments on guideline-following and artifact-generation tasks show that specifications can serve not merely as behavioral guidance, but as authority over compliant execution and completion.
2609.29921.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理越來越多地在單一的代理迴圈中結合生成、決策、執行和自我評估。儘管它們在外部規範下運作，例如任務指示、指導方針、輸出模式和可重用技能，但這些規範通常仍然是同一模型的上下文，該模型進行操作並聲明完成，並未留下獨立的規範權威邊界。我們確定了兩個結果差距。理解—執行差距出現在需求被理解但在執行中未滿足的情況下；狀態—權威差距出現在代理的解釋或完成聲明未能建立所需狀態的情況下。在 SkillsBench 上，僅使用代理可見的提示、工作區信息和注入的技能規範，我們提取了 509 個源基礎的任務指令。在七個模型中，只有 79.6%—86.4% 得到滿足，而完成聲明率超過官方評估者的通過率 28.7—37.9 個百分點。因此，我們將代理提案與權威狀態分開。代理可以計劃、行動和請求完成，但只有合格提供者的可接受證據才能建立受規範管理的狀態。SpecHarness 通過將可見規範編譯成源鏈接的義務，並通過版本化的義務狀態來管理執行和最終化，將這一原則付諸實踐。可驗證的要求在運行時進行調解或驗證，而模糊或主觀的要求則保持建議性。在遵循指導方針和產生工件的任務上的實驗顯示，規範不僅可以作為行為指導，還可以作為對合規執行和完成的權威。
